adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic.rb`, `expandable_first_post?` was changed from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`, and there is no replacement check like `EmbeddableHost.exists?`. The updated spec even fabricates an `:embeddable_host` in the “with an emeddable host” context, suggesting host presence was intended to gate the behavior, but the method doesn’t use it.
